Car Retail Sales Oct 2026 - Maruti, Tata, Mahindra, Hyundai, Kia, Toyota, Skoda VW, MG, Honda

KS
By Kabir Sharma Indian Automotive & SUV Specialist • via Rushlane.com Wire
⚡ Visual Story
Source & Photography: Rushlane.com Wire Dispatch Verified Editorial Asset
⚡ Executive Takeaways & Key Highlights
  • India’s passenger vehicle retail sales stood at 5,07,768 units in October 2026, registering a 14.23% year-on-year (YoY) decline compared to 5,92,032 units sold in October 2025.
  • However, sales recorded a strong month-on-month (MoM) growth of 18.86% over the 4,27,213 units retailed in September 2026 .
  • Official reporting verified via Rushlane.com news desk.
⚡ EDITORIAL TAKE • KABIR SHARMA Indian Automotive & SUV Specialist

Bharat NCAP Safety Standards & Indian Road Readiness

In India's rapidly evolving automotive landscape, crashworthiness and real-world durability are driving consumer purchase decisions like never before. As reported by Rushlane.com, indigenous automakers like Tata Motors and Mahindra are setting global safety benchmarks while optimizing suspension and ground clearance for unpredictable road conditions.

Big Picture: Upcoming monthly FADA retail delivery reports and Bharat NCAP rating scorecards will reveal which domestic models capture mass-market dominance.

India’s passenger vehicle retail sales stood at 5,07,768 units in October 2026, registering a 14.23% year-on-year (YoY) decline compared to 5,92,032 units sold in October 2025. However, sales recorded a strong month-on-month (MoM) growth of 18.86% over the 4,27,213 units retailed in September 2026 .

📌 The Core Development

This YoY decline can largely be attributed to a shift in the festive calendar, with key occasions such as Dhanteras and Diwali falling in November this year. Dhanteras will be celebrated on November 6, followed by Diwali on November 8, 2026, pushing a significant portion of festive vehicle purchases into the following month. However, despite the annual decline, October 2026 recorded the third-highest October retail sales in history, highlighting the underlying strength of this segment.

Cumulative retail sales for the period April-October 2026 period also remained encouraging. YTD sales increased by 16.14% to 30,68,353 units, up from 26,35,837 units retailed during the corresponding period last year.

🔍 Background & Sector Context

In a fuel wise breakup, petrol/ethanol cars dominated with a 41.60% share while diesel held a 16.57% share and CNG/LPG commanded a 24.59% share. There was a significant rise in hybrid (strong + mild) and EVs which improved their market shares to 9.94% and 7.38% respectively. Urban and rural demand ended on a positive note with a 20.10% and 16.90% growth.

Maruti Suzuki continued to dominate the passenger vehicle retail market, registering sales of 2,11,996 units in October 2026 and commanding a market share of 41.75%. Tata Motors secured a No. 2 position with 73,449 units, overtaking Mahindra, which recorded sales of 64,982 units.

📊 Industry & Real-World Impact

Tata Motors maintained an advantage of 8,467 units over Mahindra during the past month. However, both automakers strengthened their market positions, with market shares of 14.47% and 12.80%, respectively.

🔮 Strategic Outlook & What Lies Ahead

Hyundai Motor at No. 4 suffered a sales setback to 58,099 units in Oct 2026 from 69,458 units sold in Oct 2025 while Kia India overtook Toyota with 30,799 unit sales. Toyota sales dipped to 28,727 units from 38,367 units on a YoY basis taking down market share to 6%.

VW Skoda Group, which saw retail sales at 9,150 units in the past month, suffered a sequential decline in its market share to 1.80% from 2.27% held in the same month last year when sales had stood at 13,459 units.
